story.title: Golu goes to town
paragraphs_en: "Mummy when are we going to the city? Rita saw a big and grey monster there. It went 'Chhook Chhook' I want to see it too.", Golu told Mummy.
"Golu, it is a train, not a monster. It helps people reach different places if they have a ticket. It is a nice and fast way to travel.", Mummy said.
Golu still had many things to tell her mother, "Mummy, Appu saw a bird much bigger than you. It was long and was too big to fit into a nest."
Mummy started to laugh and said,"It is an airplane, a bird cannot be bigger than me! Airplanes can be expensive but did you know that airplanes can travel faster than trains?
"Rani sat in a bullock cart with a steering wheel and many buttons.That bullock cart also had a box that gave out cold air.",Golu told.
"That is a car. A car travels slower than a train. Cars need fuel to work. Car has four wheels"
Mummy, I heard there is some pond much bigger than our pond, you can not see the other side. It has big boats bigger than village.
That is not a pond but Sea. And huge boat is not a boat but ship. Ships are main mode of trade and transporting goods between countries.
﻿Mummy, let's go to city. I want to see Car, Train, Bus, Airplane and Ship. I have only seen bullock cart till now.
